spec.name: codex-adapter-removed
spec.intent: Remove the codex adapter. census @ 8753f969 (local://what-ships-census.md): 238 lines in 27 files. Delete packages/forge/src/adapters/codex/{events,index,render}.ts and packages/forge/test/adapters/codex-hooks.test.ts, and drop codex-hooks from gate-convicts.test.ts. Set the registry's HarnessName to 'claude' | 'omp', so `--harness codex` is refused by adapterByName naming the known harnesses. Remove the port op scopeOrientation, which only codex implemented: its HarnessAdapter member, its branch in project/index.ts, and its tree.test.ts case. Reword the codex comments across the forge src (harness-adapter.ts, project/index.ts, realization.ts, deploy/*, cli/commands/deploy.ts, core/body.ts, core/exemplify/skill-cell.ts, adapters/claude/render.ts, adapters/omp/{events,index,render}.ts), the schema src (hook-cell.ts, hook/index.ts, index.ts) and canon hooks/stance-guardrail.ts:697. Keep omp's verbatim 'Claude/Codex-compatible' upstream quotes. Keep the port's degrade members (preloadsSkills, scopes, unnarrowed, agentExt). Regenerate targets and commit only stance-judge.sh. Add a changeset: @cratylus/forge minor (a harness removed) and @cratylus/canon patch.
accept: `pnpm build && pnpm exec cratylus project --harness codex --out "$(mktemp -d)"` exits non-zero, and its stderr names the known harnesses `claude, omp`. At 8753f969 it exits 0.
`git grep -n scopeOrientation -- packages` prints nothing. At 8753f969 it has hits.

`git grep -n -i codex -- . ':!records' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!.changeset'` prints exactly the 3 verbatim quotes of omp's 'Claude/Codex-compatible' doc comment (omp/events.ts, omp/render.ts, omp.test.ts). At 8753f969 it prints 491 lines.
`rm -rf .cratylus && pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm project && pnpm test` is green, and `pnpm --filter @cratylus/canon run stance-guard:test` exits 0.
